prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / focused single revision.
Input 1 is the first-pass portrait EDIT TARGET. Input 2 is the selected historical identity ONLY. Inputs 3-5 are coarse pixel style-only examples. Keep the same person, woman in her THIRTIES, face identity, age, complexion and three-quarter angle looking viewer left. One HEAD-only portrait in 74:100 aspect. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. No props, hands, torso, broad shoulders, text or frame.
Make this specific structural revision, not a crop: SHORTEN exposed neck drastically by TWO THIRDS. Current chin-to-collar is about 15 logical pixels. New jaw should sit directly above collar with ONLY 4-5 logical pixels visible neck. Narrow plain collar strip in the bottom 5-7% only. Lower head hair volume at the top and redraw a larger face in the freed space. The face, nose, cheeks and adult jaw must dominate, not tall hairstyle or neck. Keep all hair and ears complete with 3 logical pixels clear transparent margin above and 2 at both sides. Do not cut off hair, ear or collar.
Coarse 74x100 logical-pixel design with broad hard connected facial planes: 4-6 flat skin tones, strong adult nose bridge and cheekbone blocks, angular jaw. Maximum 32 muted working colors. Eye whites must be TINY DIM WARM GRAY SLITS, half the current area, not bright cream rectangular blocks. Dark small pupils and no gleam.
Merge the many parallel hair highlight ribbons into ONLY FOUR LARGE UNEVEN CONNECTED masses, with 2-3 broad irregular stepped boundary shapes. NO long thin parallel stripes, no outlining individual strands, no glossy accents, no tiny separated flecks. Much less top bulk but preserve original part and tied-back hairstyle. No antialiasing, dithering, gradient, noise, soft shading or filtered smooth painting. This is an actual imagegen redraw, final NN/palette export is a disclosed non-native derivative.
VERE / 维芮: retain warm chestnut loose side-swept hair, the contained low loose braid on viewer right and small dull orange-brown tie, slender mature face, straight nose and modest pointed chin. Expression must be calm guarded dignity. LOWER the inner ends of BOTH brows to almost HORIZONTAL, flatten the peaked central forehead, one outer eyebrow subtly more alert. No worried arch, pleading, sorrow or anger. Mouth CLOSED and almost LEVEL with only natural asymmetry, no downturned pout. Do not masculinize or make teenage. Clothing collar MUST be principally NEUTRAL COOL GRAY from the current old-academy-robe jacket, blue-gray only in tiny darkest shadow, tiny dull off-white inner line. The v1 collar is too blue: reduce saturation substantially. No insignia, no family identity inferred, no rescue or sale outcome.
